name: Greenwood Beach Resort
primary_cta: Check dates and book (their direct-book.com engine, opened with the guest's room, dates and adults)
brand_truth: Pauline and Antoine's small beachfront resort at Port Howe, the south end of Cat Island, where the water decides the day: kitesurfing, reef snorkelling and, from March to June, oceanic whitetip dives.
buyer: Divers, kiters and couples from the US, Canada and France planning weeks or months ahead on a phone, comparing with Fernandez Bay and OTA listings; fear: hard journey, unclear rooms.

direction.type: T01 Monumental serif (Noto Serif Display 300 + Source Serif 4)
direction.why: Their own water photography is the asset; a letterboxed film lets each photo own the screen while all type sits on limestone bars, so nothing needs an overlay on bright sand and sky.

tier_visual_why: A beach resort reached by plane and road; their own photographs carry the place, and no real-time 3D would explain the product better. Wow comes from the pinned letterbox film (scroll-scrubbed crossfades, slow Ken Burns) and monumental type.
concept_type: booking: room picker with dates handing off to their direct-book engine, plus whitetip package enquiry and getting-here guide

images.credit: Greenwood Beach Resort / Pauline Vaz Branco (watermark)

critic_note: Independent critic re-score after fix pass 1 (above). Fix pass 2 (final) applied; per coordinator instruction state set to built. Photography and references were 3 before pass 2.
current_site_findings: Identical room descriptions; home and rooms page attach different photos to each room.
Dead buttons: View room, Discover activities, Book your activities, Lunch, Dinner.
Whitetip season, their strongest draw, buried on a sub-page.
'Paradise' and 'private escape' headline; Port Howe never named.
Getting-here guide not linked from rooms or booking.
Star-graphic review cards including an unnamed 'Guest Review'.
pitch_line: Your photographs of the whitetips and the kite beach are better than any resort's on Cat Island; this concept turns them into a film of one day at Port Howe and hands every guest straight to your own booking engine with their dates filled in.
assumptions: Room-to-photo assignment follows the rooms page (Family = Cat-Island-Greenwood-room, King = King-size-AC-room); the homepage has them the other way round.
Room amenities (ceiling fan, air conditioning, wicker chairs, louvred windows, garden door) are read from their own room photos.
direct-book deep link uses roomTypeId 367604 (King) / 367936 (Family) and rateId 749316, as seen in their rooms page links; parameters to verify with the engine.
Kite hero hotlinks the 1024x683 size (seen in an earlier session), falling back to the 768x512 size seen today.
'Atlantic shore' from the Epic Diving third-party description (pink-sand Atlantic beach).
notes: Generation 2 rebuild, 2026-11-20. fix passes 1 and 2 applied. One CTA system: teal is the only filled button; desktop floating black button deleted; phones get a safe-area teal bar (hidden on first screen and at the footer, concept tag lifted above it); whitetip form button is outlined
Booking strip enlarged into a ticket line: custom date field (showPicker), large steppers, 72px teal button
End credits: full-width two-column roll in three groups (journey, day, house) with tabular times and phones, address on one line
Rooms headline no longer hidden under the header; empty band after the rooms link removed; meal table columns widened and left column sticky
fix_pass_2: Hero photo re-cropped (hosts lower in the frame, less sky); Wind chapter now uses the wider open-water kite shot

End credits rebuilt as a real end roll on the teal ground: sticky frame with faded edges, right-aligned italic labels and left values at full width, generous leading, ending on Then, the beach and the CTA; whitetip section moved before rooms so the two teal fields never touch
